The '''Kalsunor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]].

==History==
In [[3638 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Republic succeeded in penetrating the [[Stygian Caldera]] and [[Battle of the Kalsunor system|captured]] the Kalsunor system.<ref name="TOR" />
